description: CURRENT_AVAILABLE_ROLES() - a JSON array string of the roles the session can use: the active role, the current user's granted roles, and the closure over roles granted to roles, listed alphabetically. Converted 1:1 from functions/CurrentAvailableRolesTest (now retired); the Java class compared the text against a separately-queried CURRENT_ROLE(), which the converted suite does inside one statement, and its indexOf ordering check becomes a POSITION comparison. Roles are account-level, so the hierarchy test revokes its grant and drops the roles it creates.

steps.sql: GRANT ROLE inner_r TO ROLE outer_r
GRANT ROLE outer_r TO ROLE SYSADMIN
REVOKE ROLE outer_r FROM ROLE SYSADMIN
